Ben —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear sprint outline. A few quick notes from our security ops side:

- Transfer mechanism: FortyTwo prefers S3 push with pre-signed URLs (our ingestion service is behind a short-lived signed URL workflow). We can accept either, but pre-signed push reduces our infra complexity.
- Retention: For archival artifacts we ask for at least 90 days of retention; pen-test raw output can be ephemeral but we will request hashed fingerprints for long-term traceability.
- Redaction: Greg's team will produce both raw and sanitized summaries. For integration tests, please share sanitized samples first.

We reviewed the scope doc and added inline comments (minor edits). We also have a standard vendor assessment checklist — happy to map that to your evidence workbook during the trial.

Can we schedule a 30-minute runbook walkthrough on Monday (Sep 6) 10:00am PT? I'll invite our SRE lead.
